generate_all_substrings: generate all substrings of a string and store them in a list
lexicographically_sort_substrings: sort all substrings of a string in lexicographical order
concatenate_sorted_substrings: concatenate all lexicographically sorted substrings of a string into one result
test_f_filled_against_f_gold: test the f_filled implementation against the f_gold reference using sample inputs
compute_substring_count: compute the total number of substrings for a string of length n
